People: Sophie Arnould (author, Wikidata Q435935), died 1802; Albéric Deville (editor, Wikidata Q41569220), died 1832. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Arnould, Sophie, 1740-1802; Deville, Albéric, 1773-1832 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Arnoldiana, ou Sophie Arnould et ses contemporaines: recueil choisi d ..., Gerard, 1813, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/arnoldianaousop00collgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 36%, 57%, 71% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Albéric Deville, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
